requirements.observed: A fresh judge browser opens one HTTPS URL without installing an extension.
The target WebMCP host lists at least one page-registered tool.
An agent invokes a discovered page tool with recorded input and output.
The human-visible page changes because of that exact tool call.
Removing the named Cloudflare primitive makes the demonstrated behavior fail, lose durability, or lose its enforced authority boundary.
One denied or revoked operation is visible to the human and recorded in the receipt.
The receipt names immutable inputs, the tool call, output, visible sentinel, primitive, authority result, and elapsed time.

winnerRule: A candidate is eligible only if every requirement passes. If several pass, choose the candidate with the fewest candidate-owned source lines, then the shortest observed elapsed time.
combinationRule: Do not combine candidates before comparison. A losing candidate may contribute exhaust only after the winner is frozen.
